content.title: Follow the contact-page submissions link to the submissions area
content.test_md_blob:
# Follow the contact-page submissions link to the submissions area

> Prove the contact page tells the reader to quote a SUB- reference number and routes them to `/my-submissions` for submission help.

## Step 1

Open {{contact_page_url}} in a browser as the Fernwood Press contact page.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-41, ac-42

On the contact page, review the submission-help copy near the support details, then assert the page tells the reader to quote their `SUB-` reference number and shows a link to `/my-submissions`.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-43

From the same contact page, use the `/my-submissions` link and wait for the destination page to load, then assert the browser URL contains `/my-submissions`.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: Open {{contact_page_url}} in a browser as the Fernwood Press contact page.
    step: 1
  - objective: On the contact page, review the submission-help copy near the support details, then assert the page tells the reader to quote their `SUB-` reference number and shows a link to `/my-submissions`.
    step: 2
    verifies:
      - ac-41
      - ac-42
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: absolute
      operand: /my-submissions
      operator: contains
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-43
    objective: From the same contact page, use the `/my-submissions` link and wait for the destination page to load, then assert the browser URL contains `/my-submissions`.
    step: 3
    verifies:
      - ac-43
scenario: Open the contact page and follow the submissions guidance link
title: Follow the contact-page submissions link to the submissions area

content.title: Review the published support details on the contact page
content.test_md_blob:
# Review the published support details on the contact page

> Prove the contact page presents the heading, support hours, and phone number an author needs before contacting support.

## Step 1

Open {{contact_page_url}} in a browser as the Fernwood Press contact page.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-38, ac-39, ac-40

On the loaded contact page, review the page heading and support details, then assert the heading reads `Contact & support`, the support hours text reads `Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm.`, and the phone number `(555) 020-0200` is shown.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: Open {{contact_page_url}} in a browser as the Fernwood Press contact page.
    step: 1
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: absolute
      operand: Contact & support
      operator: equals
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-38
    objective: On the loaded contact page, review the page heading and support details, then assert the heading reads `Contact & support`, the support hours text reads `Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm.`, and the phone number `(555) 020-0200` is shown.
    step: 2
    verifies:
      - ac-38
      - ac-39
      - ac-40
scenario: Open the contact page and review the published support details
title: Review the published support details on the contact page

judgements.rationale: [value_score] Ranked first because it proves the use case's only interactive outcome: the reader is guided to quote a `SUB-` reference and can route directly into `/my-submissions`.
[value_score] Ranked second because it proves the static support details are present, which is important but behaviorally simpler than the navigation path.

[self_critique] Oracle-proves-promise check passed: the written check reuses ac-43's `/my-submissions` operand exactly, and the tagged steps separately prove the guidance text and link presence. Technique fit is appropriate for a happy-path navigation promise. No source-defined negative case was omitted because the page has no alternate link target, access gate, or invalid input. The assertions were kept narrow to visible guidance text, link presence, and destination URL only.

[self_critique] Oracle-proves-promise check passed: the written check reuses ac-38's exact heading text, while the same tagged step also proves the literal hours and phone details from ac-39 and ac-40. Technique fit is appropriate for a static content-review path. No source-defined negative case was omitted because the source describes only published content on a public page. The assertion was kept narrow to the three promised support details and does not infer any unpromised layout or styling behavior.
